title: Notes app glow-up
brief: Smoke fixture: two theme directions for a small team notes app.

before.headline: 33 values: 11 colours · 5 font sizes · 3 weights · 8 spacing values · 4 radii · 2 shadows

variations.name: Ledger
variations.idea: A calm, ruled notebook: serif headings, one blue action, a generous reading column.

notes.market: Team notes tools earn trust with calm neutrals and one action colour (category.md, table stakes 1).
notes.signature: A ruled line under every section heading.
notes.convention: Neutral ground, blue action, sidebar on desktop.
notes.different: A serif display face where the category uses grotesks.
notes.ripple: Settings and onboarding take the ruled headings too.
notes.composition: Dashboard leads with this week's count, like the category's calm tools (category.md, table stakes 1); a reading column suits a notes product.

variations.name: Studio
variations.idea: A drafting table: square corners, hairline borders, a technical grotesk.

notes.market: Keeps the category's calm neutrals (table stakes 1) and swaps softness for precision.
notes.ripple: Every card in the app gets corner ticks.
notes.composition: Same dashboard-first order; the drafting-table theme earns a denser split layout rather than a reading column.
